name: Spectra
description: Dual-instrument optical UI verification referee over stdio (Meta SAM 3.1 segmentation + Pixel NCC template matching). Verification and check tools can upload local MP4 video to Meta when an API key is configured, invariant compilation can write output files, and closed-loop repair requests external model patches, so all tools require review. Off until you turn it on.
saferAlternatives: Run spectra_verify over stdio as a pre-commit or pre-merge optical gate on settled UI clips (.mp4); accept only the verdict value "pass", and fail closed on errors, "fail", and "inconclusive".
Keep spectra_closed_loop and spectra_compile_invariant in review state so disk writes and CSS repair patches synthesized via remote inference are inspected before modifying repository stylesheets.
Configuring META_API_KEY or BASETEN_API_KEY enables uploading local MP4 clips to external model APIs; omit API keys to restrict evaluation strictly to local cached deterministic fixtures in CI.
